final.summary: ETP power dropped to standby 14:15-16:15 and outfall flow was zero with pH staying near neutral, consistent with a planned stop and no discharge. After restart power rose and outfall pH remained 7.0-7.7 through the treatment interval. The equalization tank level is missing for the whole treatment interval, so it cannot be confirmed that arriving wastewater was held during the stop.

result.note: ETP balance: treated flow reaching the outfall vs outfall flow (same time). Boundary balance: intake vs outfall + losses + sludge water + tank storage change (reuse cancels).
